name: Araki Shinjugai
source:
Likes: Music, running, being alone
Dislikes: Too much attention, pressure

Araki is a shy member of the athletic team of Haruka Academy. She's normally silent, introverted, and doesn't speak much to other people - which makes Shinn's straightforwardness towards her surprising and shocking. Ritsuko tends to boss her around.
